calls.title: MVF Global & GrowthBook Demo
calls.summary: The meeting highlighted the company's extensive experimentation program, developed over 18 years, crucially embedded in its marketing strategy and driving significant revenue, generating millions of monthly impressions. With approximately 1,000 tests per year and a 10% win rate, each success yields around £15,000 in additional monthly revenue. The team of 10 seeks cost-effective solutions to replace existing spending on Optimizely, estimated at £80-100k annually. Transitioning to GrowthBook requires rehiring metrics and involves complex integration, including local traffic splitting and Snowflake data architecture. The visual editor's AI-driven capabilities and integration with Figma were also discussed, emphasizing user-friendliness, albeit with a need for team onboarding and adaptation.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, experimentation, feature flags, Snowflake integration, API, visual editor
calls.action_items:
**James Shannon**
Follow up with MVF on API capabilities regarding JavaScript/CSS injection for experiments to clarify if GrowthBook supports a single endpoint similar to Optimizely (46:15)
Provide pricing options that are competitively lower than MVF's current Optimizely spend to support GrowthBook's commercial discussions (57:57)
Arrange a follow-up call to discuss commercial terms and next steps with MVF's Billy Amps to maintain engagement and progress the sales process (59:00)

**Billy Amps**
Review and present potential pricing proposals from GrowthBook to MVF’s leadership team to facilitate decision-making (56:29)
Continue discussions with GrowthBook on a weekly or as-appropriate basis to maintain momentum and explore product fit and commercial terms (58:22)
